decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed development would enhance the appearance of the site and would not be detrimental to the interests of visual amenity or public safety and would improve the accessibility and service provision of Harnage House. The proposal accords with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities) H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions) of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan (2003) and the Council's Think Access Guidelines.
description: Erection of a new entrance canopy lobby and internal alterations to building.
